About this item

  • INSULATED SPORTS WATER BOTTLE: Goodbye sweat! The double wall insulation makes the Iron Flask sweat-free! It keeps your drink COLD for up to 24 hours, and HOT for up to 12 hours.
  • LEAK-PROOF Carabiner Straw Lid: Enjoy spill-free sipping with our best-selling, LEAK-PROOF straw lid. Effortlessly clips onto bags for easy carrying—no spills, ever!
  • 18/8 PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL: The Iron Flask is made of 18/8 Stainless steel that is BPA free and non-toxic. It will never leave a metal taste or rust. HAND WASH ONLY WITH SOAPY HOT WATER!
  • THE PERFECT GIFT: Stay hydrated during outdoor adventures with our top-rated water bottles, we have everything Mom & Dad need to stay refreshed and energized. Give the gift of thirst-quenching this Mother’s and Father’s Day!
  • THE ULTIMATE LIFESTYLE GIFT: Choose a color that speaks to your friends and family to create the perfect, personalized gift! Great for the outdoor or gym enthusiast that will enjoy a memorable product they'll remember, & due to its durability will stand the test of time.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers praise the water bottle's temperature retention, noting it keeps water cold all day and stays hot all day, while also appreciating its value for money as one of their best investments. The bottle features a sleek black design, fits well in vehicle cup holders, and comes with three different lids to choose from. While some customers say it stands up to tough treatment, others report it breaks quickly, and while some say it doesn't leak at all, others find it leaks excessively.

  • LEAK-PROOF Carabiner Straw Lid: Enjoy spill-free sipping with our best-selling, LEAK-PROOF straw lid. Effortlessly clips onto bags for easy carrying—no spills, ever!
  • 18/8 PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL: The Iron Flask is made of 18/8 Stainless steel that is BPA free and non-toxic. It will never leave a metal taste or rust. HAND WASH ONLY WITH SOAPY HOT WATER!

Product Description

Take advantage of our special introductory price.

Your search for the best sports water bottle is over. Say hello to the best sports water bottle, thermos.

Plastic water bottles? NO THANKS!

Iron Flask water bottle is made of premium 18/8 stainless steel, 100% BPA free. This bottle will keep your drinks cold and hot for many hours. It will never sweat, no matter the temperature of the drink.

Tired of poor quality water bottles that sweat and leak?

We've all tried bottles that sweat and leak. Well, try the iron flask that comes with three different lids (sports straw lid with two different straws, flip top lid and a stainless steel lid)

Looking for a water bottle to carry anywhere?

This double wall insulated water bottle will meet all your needs. Whether you fill it with boiling water or a pack of ice, the bottle will never be hot or cold to carry. You can use it in the office, gym, or even for outdoor activities such as camping and hiking.

What are you waiting for? Don't hesitate to order the #IRONFLASK already!

Share a photo of your Iron Flask on Instagram with #ironflask and tagging @ironflask

Please note that only the 14oz, 18oz and 22oz iron flask fits cup holders.
